Game.pokeLoungeDesc: Invite friends with a room code to catch and train Pokémon in the same village. Bring your own teams to a three-round championship.
Game.pokeLoungeShareDesc: Catch and train Pokémon with friends, then battle across three tournament rounds. An unofficial Pokémon fan game you can play together in your browser.
Game.introEyebrow: That first-adventure feeling. This time, together.
Game.introPlayNote:
No install. No login.
Desktop · Mobile
Game.introStarterPrompt: Who will be your first partner?
Game.introPreviewTitle: Two ways to begin, inside the game.
Game.introPreviewDescription: Share one village with up to 8 human and AI players combined. Alternate exploration and tournaments, with the final standings decided by points earned across three rounds.
Game.introWorldDescription: Find, catch, and train Pokémon in the tall grass. Choose 90 seconds, 3 minutes, or 5 minutes of exploration per round.
Game.introPartyDescription: Pick a starter and get ready for your adventure. AI fills the empty seats when fewer friends join.
Game.introMultiplayerDescription: Face your friends in the tournament with the team you trained. Explore and build your team again each round; total points across three rounds decide the winner.
Game.introFinalTitle: Which of you will be the champion?
Game.introFinalDescription: Create a room and send the invite code to your friends. An adventure in the same village becomes your own Pokémon showdown.
Game.introGuideAlt: The pixel art Poke Lounge guide welcoming you to a new adventure
Game.introPartyAlt: An actual game screen showing starter Pokémon selection
Game.introWorldAlt: An actual game screen showing exploration in the village and tall grass
Game.introBattleAlt: An actual turn-based battle screen showing Pokémon move selection
Game.introFanNotice: An unofficial fan game made with love and respect for Pokémon. All related rights belong to their respective owners.
Game.introChoosePartner: Tap a partner to say hello.
Game.introChikoritaDescription: Start a green little adventure with your Grass-type partner.
Game.introCyndaquilDescription: Set off on a new adventure with a little spark by your side.
Game.introTotodileDescription: Get ready for an adventure with your Water-type partner.
Game.introPreviewHint: Pick a step to explore the actual game screens.
Game.introVideoDescription: From choosing a partner to exploring tall grass and entering the tournament. Take a look at moments from the actual game.
Game.introVideoLabel: Actual Poke Lounge gameplay showing partner selection, exploration, and the tournament
Game.introPartnerNote: Just a first hello! Choose your actual partner when you enter the game.
Game.introFriendsTitle: Today, your friend is your rival!
Game.introFriendsCapacity: Up to 8 humans and AI combined. AI fills the empty seats.
Game.introFriendsInviteDescription: Create a private room and share its invite code. Meet in the same room with no installation or login.
Game.introFriendsExploreDescription: Explore the same village while each of you catches and trains a team. Your encounters and training shape the next battle.
Game.introFriendsBattleTitle: Raise a team. Face your friends.
Game.introFriendsBattleDescription: Your fellow adventurers become tournament rivals! Alternate exploration and battles for three rounds, with total points deciding the final standings.
